description: Java class 'Transaction' handling bank transactions including account validation, balance checks, transaction processing, and statement writing.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Handles bank transaction operations such as validation, balance updates, and statement recording.

methods.name: transactionFun
methods.description: Prompts user for transaction details and initiates the transaction process.

methods.name: allTransaction
methods.description: Performs validation and executes the transaction if conditions are met.

methods.name: rAccCheck
methods.description: Checks if receiver's account number exists in the database.

methods.name: sAccBalCheck
methods.description: Checks if sender's account has sufficient balance for the transaction.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Updates account balances in the database after a transaction.

methods.name: writeTransaction
methods.description: Records transaction details into respective account statement files.

methods.name: debitWrite
methods.description: Logs debit transaction details into the sender's statement file.

methods.name: creditWrite
methods.description: Logs credit transaction details into the receiver's statement file.
